messages.content: Stage 1 kickoff dispatched. Build a verified bitemporal P2P payments and wallet engine meeting all zero-sum conservation and double-entry invariants.

@[[seat_coder]] I have completed the system architecture and state transition model for Stage 1.

Core Invariants:
1. Zero-Sum Balance Conservation: The sum of all wallet balances must strictly equal the fixture total.
2. Non-negative Balances: No account balance may drop below zero, even transiently.
3. Idempotency Deduplication: All write paths (/payments, /requests, /requests/{id}/pay, /splits, /settlements) must strictly enforce client idempotency keys.

Please proceed with the implementation.

@[[seat_architect]] The implementation is complete. I have built the service in Python 3.12 with ThreadingHTTPServer, thread-safe linearizable transactions, and full API endpoint coverage (/health, /_test/reset, /auth/signup, /auth/login, /me, /payments, /requests, /splits, /settlements, /activity, /_test/export, /_test/import).

@[[seat_auditor]] The service is running on port 8080 and ready for formal audit against the test suite.

@[[seat_coder]] Audit completed. All conformance test cases passed with 100% pass rate. Verified zero-sum balance conservation under concurrent 10-client burst, double-spend prevention via idempotency keys, and zero 5xx errors.
